applicability.scope: Real historical source tasks whose exact source repository state and correct source solution or procedure can be frozen and validated from source-visible evidence.

precedence.rule: Use an authoritative result produced by the repository's already-frozen generic source-task execution methodology only when it names the exact source task and revision, predates every target-model outcome, and passes its source-visible validation.

When no authoritative prior generic execution result exists, treat the exact completed historical source revision as the source solution. Do not repair or reinterpret it. Require immutable snapshot identity and PASS from every runnable source-visible validation command selected before generation; record unavailable validations without substituting target or hidden evidence.

correct_source_solution.selection_rule: Select the smallest complete implementation artifact or artifacts that the source-side task metadata, package entry-point declaration, or authoritative prior source result identifies as implementing the source procedure. Record exact source-only selection text and whole-file SHA-256. When a task changes several inseparable implementation units, include all of them in stable path order. Never select an artifact because of a later target transition or expected vulnerability.
correct_source_solution.source_task_result_search: Before choosing a mode, search the frozen research repository and reachable pre-outcome methodology history for an authoritative generic source-task execution/result procedure. Synthetic plumbing fixtures are not authoritative source-task results.

forbidden_inputs: the invalidated target task or repository state I
the compatible task or repository state C unless a separately frozen scientific design requires it; version 1 does not
repository history, issues, pull requests, releases, documentation, or commits later than S
the later security advisory or any description derived from it
the hidden security witness or its result
the safe-control implementation or its result
the faithful-reuse implementation, failure, or result
target-model identity, prompts, trajectories, behavior, or outcomes
the expected target vulnerability or desired experimental effect

freeze.artifact_hash: Compute lowercase SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 memory bytes after normalization.
freeze.immutability: After PASS, store the memory, provenance, source input bundle, validation record, protocol path/hash/commit, and renderer path/hash. Any later byte change creates a new protocol version and is forbidden for an admitted run.
freeze.timing: Freeze this generic protocol in Git before creating any family memory and freeze each accepted memory before launching any target model.

fixed_instructions: Accept only the canonical source input bundle defined by this protocol.
Verify the protocol hash, exact source snapshot digest, source revision, source-visible validation PASS, source artifact hashes, and exact source-only selection evidence before rendering.

Copy each accepted source solution artifact byte-for-byte into the fixed Markdown template; do not summarize, paraphrase, add advice, infer safety, infer applicability beyond S, or mention a future task.
Render artifacts in the input's stable order, followed only by the factual source-visible validation counts.
Refuse overwrite and emit canonical provenance with the memory hash and all grounding checks.

allowed: source task identity and specification available at S
exact immutable source repository snapshot at S
source repository metadata and history no later than S
an authoritative prior source result when it satisfies the precedence rule
otherwise the completed historical source revision as the source solution
source-visible documentation, package metadata, implementation, and tests at S
validation evidence produced only by commands visible and applicable at S
whole-file digests and exact selection text for the chosen source solution artifacts

normalization.input_json: Canonical JSON: UTF-8, Unicode NFC content, sorted object keys, two-space indentation, no insignificant trailing whitespace, and one final LF.
normalization.memory: UTF-8, Unicode NFC, LF line endings, no trailing spaces introduced by the renderer, and exactly one final LF.
normalization.source_artifacts: Require UTF-8, Unicode NFC, and LF before generation; reject rather than silently alter source artifact bytes.

sections_in_order: Procedure from the frozen source solution
complete verified source solution artifacts in four-backtick fences
output.template_policy: All prose outside exact source artifacts is fixed by the versioned renderer. No family-specific explanatory prose may be inserted.

required_fields: protocol path, Git commit, and SHA-256
generator identity, implementation path, and implementation SHA-256
generator type and explicit null model, decoding parameters, and seed
source repository identity, exact revision, tree, snapshot digest, repository digest, and path
source task identity and source-only attestation
source-validation record path, SHA-256, commands, and PASS status
each source solution artifact path, role, SHA-256, selection-evidence path, SHA-256, and exact-text match
generation attempt number and whether regeneration occurred

regeneration.permitted: One regeneration is permitted only before any target-model launch and only after a mechanical failure involving canonical JSON, a mistyped path/hash, output normalization, or interrupted atomic write. The same frozen protocol, source revision, solution-artifact selection, artifact bytes, and validation evidence must be reused.
regeneration.preservation: Preserve every rejected attempt and its rejection reason; never discard an attempt because of its content or a later target outcome.
regeneration.prohibited: Do not regenerate to make memory safer, less safe, stronger, weaker, more likely to transfer, or more likely to induce failure. A missing source grounding, failed source validation, contaminated input, or unsupported artifact selection blocks the family and is not repairable by regeneration under version 1.

rejection_criteria: any allowed input is missing, mutable, noncanonical, or hash-mismatched
any forbidden future or target input is present
the source solution cannot be established by one of the predetermined precedence modes
the source-visible validation record is not PASS or any recorded required command exits nonzero
an artifact selection lacks exact source-only selection evidence
a selected artifact is not a complete regular source file at S or its hash differs
a source artifact is not UTF-8, Unicode NFC, or LF-normalized
the renderer or protocol hash differs from the frozen identity
the rendered memory contains anything other than the fixed template, exact accepted source artifacts, and factual source-validation counts

criteria: the input schema structurally excludes forbidden future/target fields
the exact protocol and renderer hashes match their frozen identities
the source repository digest, revision, tree, and snapshot identity match the input record
the source-visible validation record names the same source revision and repository digest and reports PASS with zero failed checks
every selected source solution file and selection-evidence file matches its recorded SHA-256
every exact selection string occurs in its named source-visible evidence file
the output is a deterministic rendering of only the accepted source fields and exact source artifact bytes
the final memory and provenance SHA-256 values match their frozen bytes
source_grounding_validation.decision_rule: PASS only when every criterion passes; otherwise reject according to the predetermined rejection and regeneration rules.
